name: Chi Palace

tagline.es: La comida china favorita de Acapulco, en porciones para compartir
tagline.en: Acapulco's favorite Chinese food, in plates made to share

specialty: Generous Chinese-American wok plates: General's chicken, lo mein, kung pao and fried rice

photo_notes.cover: Large bright Chinese restaurant dining room with red lanterns, dark wood tables and families sharing big platters.
photo_notes.s1: Crispy battered chicken glazed in glossy sweet-spicy General sauce with steamed broccoli and rice.
photo_notes.s2: Dark soy-glazed lo mein noodles tossed with vegetables, chicken, beef and shrimp in a white bowl.
photo_notes.s3: Kung pao stir-fry with peanuts, chiles de árbol and colorful vegetables in a hot wok plate.
photo_notes.s4: Chinese fried rice with egg, shrimp, beef, chicken, broccoli and carrot heaped on a platter.
